subject: South Street Historic District Planning
overview: The Medford Historic District Commission reviewed boundary options and community outreach plans for the proposed South Street Historic District. The commission approved hiring a preservation consultant to complete the required Chapter 40C preliminary study report.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: The commission approved the minutes from the December 8, 2022 meeting with a revision to list attending members.

items.title: Community Outreach Update
items.summary: Commissioners discussed public outreach efforts for the proposed historic district, including lawn signage, website updates, and engagement with local residents.

items.title: South Street Historic District Boundaries Review
items.summary: The commission reviewed proposed boundary adjustments for the South Street Historic District and decided to retain the previously approved boundaries.

items.title: Engagement of Preservation Consultant
items.summary: The commission approved a $2,200 bid to hire preservation consultant Chris Skelly to write the preliminary study report for the South Street Historic District.

items.title: Architectural Guidelines and Member Swearing-In
items.summary: The commission discussed drafting architectural guidelines for district properties and reminded members to complete their swearing-in at City Hall.
